title: The Last Delivery
brief: A sealed parcel disappeared from the museum loading bay. Identify who moved it and where it went. Make exactly three links: suspect to badge record, suspect to signed instruction, destination to trolley trace.
success_text: Case solved: Noor moved the parcel to the restoration room. Her badge, signed instruction and trolley trace agree.

cards.title: Noor / Restorer
cards.body: She was preparing the restoration room for a late inspection.

cards.title: Loading bay / 18:42
cards.body: Noor's badge opened the loading bay. The courier departed at 18:20.

cards.title: Courier / Departed
cards.body: The exit camera shows the courier leaving empty-handed at 18:20.

cards.title: Move sealed parcel
cards.body: Please move this parcel to restoration before inspection. Collected by Noor at 18:43.

cards.title: Restoration room
cards.body: This room lies at the end of the east service corridor.

cards.title: East service corridor
cards.body: Fresh trolley marks run from the loading bay to the restoration room. The parcel seal was found there.
